selection: satisfy precision/recall/clean targets, then maximize recall, precision, and prefer lower threshold
no_admissible_threshold: retain 0.5 for diagnosis, acceptance remains failed
held_out: official test split, no threshold tuning on held-out results
development: fixed training-exposed calibration subset; exclude all test/gold pages and normalized texts
gold: corrected text clean-only auxiliary evaluation; no inferred error categories
diff_alignment: enumerate full pre-to-post joint reconstructions (10000 search visits maximum); preserve equivalent alternatives; quarantine unknown labels, inconsistency, or search overflow with counts
alternative_alignment_scoring: maximize one-to-one matches over one complete reconstruction per primary metric, never union event positions; labeled per-class counts use the same selected labeled scenario
canonical_diagnostics: raw exact and token diagnostics use the first deterministic full reconstruction; not primary acceptance for equivalent duplicate edits
zero_width_primary: event gap contained inclusively by predicted span
zero_width_token_diagnostic: containing token, final ordinary token at document end; project-specific rule
conflicting_token_labels: count unscorable projection documents; keep their events in primary metrics
diagnostics: record any/all location and label hits
clean record false-positive rate and descriptive Wilson interval
scope: published evaluation definitions inform this protocol; upstream private preprocessing/scoring is not exactly reproduced
